title: CHUYÊN ĐỀ 10 TỪ CHỈ LƯỢNG HSA - ĐỀ LUYỆN TẬP SỐ 1
notes: Chưa có đáp án trong dữ liệu nguồn; hệ thống không chấm điểm đề này.

questions.content: The CEO announced that _______ of the company's annual budget will be allocated to research and development.
_______ all the senior engineers agreed that the new software architecture would improve system stability significantly.
Although the lecture was quite complex, _______ students were able to understand the core concepts of quantum physics.
The marketing department has discovered that _______ of the customer feedback received last month was surprisingly positive.
_______ of the two candidates possesses the specific leadership qualities required to manage this international project
Environmental scientists warn that _______ progress has been made in reducing global carbon emissions over the last decade.
We have two available meeting rooms; one is on this floor and _______ is located in the basement.
"Could you please provide _______ more details regarding the financial discrepancies found in the quarterly audit report?"
_______ of the students failed to submit their assignments on time despite receiving multiple reminders from the professor.
_______ of endangered species in this tropical rainforest has increased significantly due to illegal logging and climate change.
Some people prefer traditional classroom learning, whereas _______ find online courses to be much more flexible and convenient.
There isn't _______ hope of finding a peaceful solution if both parties refuse to compromise on their demands.
"I don't think _______ of these two laptops is suitable for high-end video editing and professional graphic design."
The project manager spent _______ of his time coordinating between different departments to ensure the deadline was met.
_______ effort was put into the presentation, but the client decided to choose a different advertising agency instead.
According to the recent census, _______ of the population in this rural area is over sixty-five years old.
There are five books on the shelf; two are novels and _______ are academic journals regarding modern history.
Unfortunately, _______ of the information leaked to the press yesterday was highly confidential and sensitive to national security.
"Would you like _______ cup of tea while you are waiting for the manager to finish his meeting?"
There is _______ water left in the reservoir, so we must use it sparingly until the next rainy season.
Many experts believe that _______ who invests in the stock market should be prepared for potential financial losses.
The two rival companies have been competing with _______ for the dominant position in the smartphone market for years.
"I'm sorry, but I have _______ knowledge about the internal workings of the legal system in this country."
_______ of the ten candidates were selected for the final round of interviews based on their exceptional performance.
The whole city _______ decorated with colorful lights and banners to celebrate the arrival of the new year.
"Is there _______ chance that the flight will be delayed due to the thick fog at the airport?"
_______ of the twins wanted to attend the summer camp, so their parents decided to stay at home.
The professor gave _______ of the five groups a different topic to research for their final semester project.
There are several ways to solve this problem; one is through negotiation and _______ is through legal action.
"You can choose _______ of these two dresses; they both look absolutely stunning on you for the gala."
_______ of the furniture in the showroom is handcrafted by local artisans using sustainable wood from the region.
_______ of the students in the exchange program comes from a different country in Europe or Asia.
"There are _______ people who are willing to volunteer their time to help the elderly in our community."
The company has _______ interest in investing in coal power because they want to focus on green energy.
_______ of the three solutions proposed by the committee was deemed practical enough to be implemented immediately.
I have invited twenty people to the dinner party, but _______ of them have confirmed their attendance yet.
_______ member of the audience was given a brochure containing the schedule of the three-day music festival.
Some employees like to work in teams, while _______ prefer to complete their tasks independently and quietly.
"Do you have _______ suggestions for improving the efficiency of our current supply chain management system?"
There were _______ complaints from the customers regarding the long waiting times at the new city restaurant.
We have _______ time left before the train departs, so we should hurry to the station now.
I found _______ interesting articles on the internet about the latest advancements in artificial intelligence and robotics.
_______ of the two cars is in good condition; they both need extensive repairs before they can be driven.
_______ of the building was evacuated within minutes after the fire alarm was triggered by the smoke sensors.
"Could you give me _______ advice on how to prepare for the upcoming job interview at the bank?"
There are ten students in the group; four are from Vietnam and _______ are from other countries.
_______ child in the kindergarten was given a small toy as a reward for their good behavior today.
The manager spent _______ money on the renovation of the office than he had originally planned to spend.
I have _______ friends who live in New York, so I will stay with them during my trip.
There is _______ milk in the fridge, so you don't need to buy any more for breakfast.
